name: Optimization benchmark functions and suites
description: A taxonomy and analysis of commonly used optimisation benchmark functions and benchmark suites to assess optimisation algorithm performance.
reputation: Well-established reference in numerical optimization literature and widely used to benchmark optimization algorithms.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; results depend strongly on algorithm initialization, hyperparameters, and chosen test functions; risk of overfitting to popular benchmark suites; not a single unified score across functions.
